CrossMux 1.5.9 adds MQTT-powered Smart Standby dashboards and distributable .NET 10 synchronization services for Windows and Linux.

## Smart Standby

- Add a device-specific MQTT standby face that receives retained update notifications while the face is active.
- Stream the rendered BMP from the configured sync service directly to SD without buffering the image in MQTT or device RAM.
- Validate downloaded BMP files and use `.part`/`.bak` atomic replacement so failed updates retain the previous dashboard.
- Add Web Settings fields for the Smart Standby MQTT host and port.
- Add English and Simplified Chinese interface strings.

## Smart Standby Studio

- Add a professional browser-based studio at `/standby` with weather, market, and lyrics presets.
- Support text, progress, divider, remote-image, and custom-data widgets on an 800×480 canvas.
- Resolve `{{variable}}` bindings from static values or bounded HTTP JSON data sources.
- Render four-level grayscale BMP pages with SkiaSharp.
- Refresh enabled templates on a schedule and publish device-specific retained MQTT notifications.

## Server downloads

- `CrossMux.SyncService-win-x64.zip`: self-contained single-file Windows x64 service.
- `CrossMux.SyncService-linux-x64.tar.gz`: self-contained single-file Linux x64 service.
- No separately installed .NET runtime is required.

## Firmware downloads

- `firmware.bin`: international X3/X4 firmware.
- `firmware-cn.bin`: Simplified Chinese X3/X4 firmware.
- `bootloader.bin` and `partitions.bin`: shared installation support files.

## Upgrade notes

- Open the device Web Settings page and configure the File Sync Server URL plus the Smart Standby MQTT host and port.
- Enter **Apps > Standby**, then switch to the Smart Standby face. Its first screen shows the device ID required by the studio.
- Continuous Wi-Fi and MQTT increase battery use; externally powered operation is recommended for always-on dashboards.
